description: Unit tests for the ConcurrentLruCache class, validating its multi-generation eviction policies, basic cache operations, disposal behavior, and edge cases within the Orleans caching system.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruTests
classes.description: Test suite for the ConcurrentLruCache, covering cache operations, eviction policies, disposal, and boundary conditions.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruTests.ValueFactory
classes.description: Helper class to generate values for cache entries during tests, tracks creation count.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruTests.DisposableItem
classes.description: A disposable class used in tests to verify proper disposal of cache items.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruTests.DisposableValueFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating DisposableItems, tracking created items.

methods.name: FillCache
methods.description: Fills the cache with items from -1 to -capacity to set up test conditions.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the cache, conditional on debug configuration.

methods.name: GetTestAccessor
methods.description: Returns the internal test accessor for the cache, used to check internal state.

methods.name: IsInCache
methods.description: Checks whether a key is present in the cache.

methods.name: Touch
methods.description: Accesses a key to promote it within the cache's generation queues.

methods.name: GetOrAddRangeInclusive
methods.description: Adds or touches a range of keys from start to end inclusively.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateRangeInclusive
methods.description: Adds or updates a range of keys from start to end inclusively.
